facts.fact: From 15 June 2026 adult citizens confirm their electoral data at BUAP counters installed in the municipal administrations and commune administrations, feeding the national database of adult citizens that is later handed to the National Electoral Commission, on the Minister of State's word; the document does not say how the counters are connected.
facts.system: Balcões Únicos de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)

facts.fact: 254 BUAP counters, housed in municipal and commune administrations, were to be working in the 21 provinces in the first phase from 15 June 2026, against a target of 634, on the Government's figures; the count is of counters, not of municipalities, and no total of municipalities is given.
facts.system: Balcões Únicos de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)

facts.fact: The update of adult citizens' data began on 15 June 2026 at BUAP counters in municipal and commune administrations, to run until 31 March 2027, with 254 counters in a first phase and 634 intended.
facts.system: Balcões Únicos de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)

facts.fact: The operation at the BUAP counters is coordinated by an interministerial commission created by the President and headed by the Minister of State and head of the Casa Civil, with the ministers of Territorial Administration, Justice, Telecommunications and others as members, as of 15 June 2026.
facts.system: Balcões Únicos de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)
